name: Search Does Search
description:
Web results directly in system search. Type in the GNOME overview and the engine's own results page renders right there in the search list — scroll it, click it, follow the links you click without leaving the overview. Nothing is handed to a browser until you ask for it, and which browser that is stays your system default.

The page is rendered by a separate process (GNOME Shell cannot host WebKit) and the query is sent to the engine you pick in the settings — DuckDuckGo or Google — and to no one else. Requires the WebKit2 4.1 GJS typelib: gir1.2-webkit2-4.1 on Debian and Ubuntu, webkit2gtk4.1 on Fedora.
